description: This file defines the BatchClient class in the Aws\Batch namespace, which extends the AwsClient class. The class serves as a client for interacting with the AWS Batch service, providing methods for actions such as creating and managing compute environments, job queues, and jobs. It uses method annotations to declare available methods for both synchronous and asynchronous operations.
